topic: Template Function Specialization and SFINAE for Type Traits
explanation: In modern C++, template specialization and SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) are techniques used to enable or disable template instantiations based on type traits or compile-time conditions. This allows writing highly generic and efficient code that adapts to different types, facilitating type-safe function overloading and customization without runtime overhead. These features are essential for creating flexible, type-aware libraries and components in C++.
